text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This is a coincidence. Out for an evening
stroll? I, too, am—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That's, well...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
N-no, never! I'm the miracle worker! I
would never...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ahem... Excuse me. I didn't mean to
raise my voice.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Sigh... How quick I am to lose my composure upon being exposed. I still have much to learn.

Smiling at her own consternation, Fuji
Kiseki takes a deep breath and
quietly
continues.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The tryouts are special.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
They're a momentous event where runners
who've risen to racer status
take their first
definitive steps toward entering the
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Make no mistake, it's a far cry from the
scrimmage the other day. At tryouts, the
expectations are as high as the level of
each superb
runner.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But me? I'm still not...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, from what you've seen, what do
you think of me? Did I succeed in my
performance as a naturally talented and
confident Fuji
Kiseki?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Then I'm glad. I hope to always be capable
of that.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
But... the truth is,
I still lack many skills.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Today's incident is proof. If I'd been
keeping a proper eye out, as I
should've
been, that student never would have run
away.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I... I know I should be resting,
but when I think about tomorrow... I
can't fathom the
thought of sleeping as if everything's
fine.

Fuji Kiseki's fallen into deep anxiety,
making me realize she'll
continue to strain
herself so long as she can't shake this
dread.

I don't know how to make her feel
better...
What would be the best
way to raise the
spirits of an aspiring entertainer?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So long as there are people hoping for a
miraculous race, it is this
entertainer's
mission to give them a show to remember.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh? What is it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What? Where—wait, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's you! That look in your eyes...
You
found Fuji, didn't ya?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh? With what?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hmmm... All right, lemme hear the plan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain the situation to Hishi Amazon,
who graciously answers my
call for
assistance. That's when we get to work.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! What could you be—huh?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What is everyone doing here?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Nothin' special.
This trainer here asked us
to come give you a little
support for your
tryout race.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And these kiddos... Too curious for their
own good. I told 'em it's
after curfew, but
they wouldn't have it.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
We heard you were doing supersecret
drills! So that's how you're so
good! And
you're always coming to our rescue
too—just like a hero!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's why tomorrow we're going to be on
the sidelines cheering for
your victory, just
like in those superhero shows!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: And me too! Your races are always the funnest to watch! I can't wait to cheer you on!

text_block_list.name: Junior Students
text_block_list.text:
Go, Fuji! You can do it!
You're the best,
Fuji!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I don't know what to say...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: My miracles...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha... You really got me there,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I would never dream of letting down all
the younger kids. And... I
never will.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So I'm going to smile, stand tall,
and... go
home.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our efforts pay off,
and Fuji Kiseki finally
decides to return to her
dorm room and
get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No sooner than I can blink, the next
morning arrives, meaning it's time
for the
tryouts at last.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
They're round the third corner! Coming
from far outside is... the Black
Meteor, Fuji
Kiseki! She makes up for her slow start in
an instant!

text_block_list.name: Junior Students
text_block_list.text: Go for it, Fujiii!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Fears still lie within me—
I can feel them. I have much to improve on
if I ever want to
live up to my name... In the end,
I'm still an amateur.)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(But! Look at this crowd!
I'm in front of a
live audience! I will always
be proud to be
an entertainer—and I will show that to
them, right here and now!)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki has the lead into the final
stretch! She's a whopping eight
lengths
ahead of second! What a whirlwind of a
solo show!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Forget the fatigue! Show them you've got
enough left to smile! That's what Fuji
Kiseki would do! Now,
all that's left is the
big finish!)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: This... is my MIRACLE!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And Fuji Kiseki takes fiiirst!
The crowd is
roaring with applause for
that astounding
performance!

text_block_list.name: Junior Runner C
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki... Thank you so much for that
amazing race. I remember
now... my
motivation—and my dream!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I'm completely exhausted. You
know, I'm a bit of a stranger
when it comes to muscle soreness,
but this time I'm afraid of what
tomorrow will bring.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Heehee, that makes me happy!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's the job of an entertainer to live
up to
the audience's expectations.
That's what I
thought, at least...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
But at the same time, I learned that their
expectations are what give me the
greatest strength of all. I just wanted to
say... thank you for
teaching me that.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, if you're willing... would you
continue to teach me?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
With you, I feel I can show everyone a
miracle even grander than the
one I
demonstrated today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I instantly sign a contract with Fuji
Kiseki,
the miraculous entertainer
who brings joy
to all!
